law: signals are ranked by the named criteria below, never composited (#42); culling is PROPOSED here and decided only by the operator in docs/content/feed-review-queue.json — never automatic

criteria.droppedText: LINK-SAFE patterns (the wikinews-1483/1403 lesson): dangling particle after 知られる — a linked name was dropped in extraction / empty quote/paren pair — bracketed content was dropped in extraction
criteria.tooThin: news text under 300 chars — glossary entries, classical excerpts and graded beginner texts have their own natural lengths and are exempt
criteria.foreignScript: news text over 20% Latin/Cyrillic letters (watchlist, never a cull ground by itself)
criteria.ranking: most flags first, then fewest chars, then id — no composite score
